AttachPolicy.title: AttachPolicy
AttachPolicy.summary: Attaches a permission policy to an object, which can be a RAM user, RAM user group, or RAM role. After you attach a permission policy to an object, the object has the operation permissions on the resources in a specific resource group or within a specific Alibaba Cloud account.

BindSecureMobilePhone.title: BindSecureMobilePhone
BindSecureMobilePhone.summary: Binds a mobile phone number to a member of the resource account type in a resource directory for security purposes.

CancelChangeAccountEmail.title: CancelChangeAccountEmail
CancelChangeAccountEmail.summary: Cancels the email address change of a member.

CancelCreateCloudAccount.title: CancelCreateCloudAccount
CancelCreateCloudAccount.summary: Cancels the creation of a cloud account.

CancelPromoteResourceAccount.title: CancelPromoteResourceAccount
CancelPromoteResourceAccount.summary: Cancels the upgrade from a resource account to a cloud account.

ChangeAccountEmail.title: ChangeAccountEmail
ChangeAccountEmail.summary: Changes the email address that is bound to a member.

CreateAutoGroupingRule.title: Create an automatic resource group transfer rule
CreateAutoGroupingRule.summary: Creates an automatic resource group transfer rule. Two types are supported: custom transfer rules and attached-resource transfer rules.

CreateCloudAccount.title: Create a cloud account type member
CreateCloudAccount.summary: Creates a member of the cloud account type in a resource directory.

CreateControlPolicy.title: Create a custom control policy
CreateControlPolicy.summary: Calls CreateControlPolicy to create a custom control policy.

CreateFolder.title: Create a resource folder
CreateFolder.summary: Creates a resource folder by calling CreateFolder.

CreatePolicyVersion.title: Create an access policy version
CreatePolicyVersion.summary: Creates a version of an access policy by calling CreatePolicyVersion.

CreateResourceAccount.title: CreateResourceAccount
CreateResourceAccount.summary: Creates a member of the resource account type.

CreateRole.title: Create a role
CreateRole.summary: Creates a role by calling CreateRole.

DeclineHandshake.title: Decline a handshake invitation
DeclineHandshake.summary: Declines a handshake invitation by the invited Alibaba Cloud account.

DeleteAccount.title: DeleteAccount
DeleteAccount.summary: Deletes a member of the resource account type.

DeletePolicyVersion.title: DeletePolicyVersion
DeletePolicyVersion.summary: Deletes a version of a permission policy.

DeregisterDelegatedAdministrator.title: DeregisterDelegatedAdministrator
DeregisterDelegatedAdministrator.summary: Removes a delegated administrator account for a trusted service.

DestroyResourceDirectory.title: DestroyResourceDirectory
DestroyResourceDirectory.summary: Disables a resource directory. This operation cannot be undone. Therefore, exercise caution when you perform it.

DetachPolicy.title: DetachPolicy
DetachPolicy.summary: Detaches a permission policy from an object. After you detach a policy from an object, the object does not have the operation permissions on the current resource group or the resources within the current account.

DisableAssociatedTransfer.title: DisableAssociatedTransfer
DisableAssociatedTransfer.summary: Disables the Transfer Associated Resources feature.

DisableAutoGrouping.title: DisableAutoGrouping
DisableAutoGrouping.summary: Disables the Automatic Resource Transfer feature. After the feature is disabled, existing custom transfer rules and existing transfer rules for associated resources are deleted. However, existing relationships between resources and resource groups are not affected. If you still want to use this feature, you can enable it again 1 minute later.

EnableAssociatedTransfer.title: EnableAssociatedTransfer
EnableAssociatedTransfer.summary: Enables the Transfer Associated Resources feature.

EnableAutoGrouping.title: EnableAutoGrouping
EnableAutoGrouping.summary: Enables the Automatic Resource Transfer feature. After the feature is enabled, you can create, update, delete, and query transfer rules.

GetAccount.title: Retrieve member account information
GetAccount.summary: Calls GetAccount to retrieve member account information.

GetAccountDeletionCheckResult.title: GetAccountDeletionCheckResult
GetAccountDeletionCheckResult.summary: Queries the result of a member deletion check.

GetAccountDeletionStatus.title: Query member account deletion status
GetAccountDeletionStatus.summary: Queries the deletion status of a member account.

GetAutoGroupingRule.title: Query automatic resource group transfer rule information
GetAutoGroupingRule.summary: Queries the information about an automatic resource group transfer rule.

GetAutoGroupingStatus.title: GetAutoGroupingStatus
GetAutoGroupingStatus.summary: Queries the status of the Automatic Resource Transfer feature.

GetControlPolicy.title: Query control policy details
GetControlPolicy.summary: Queries the details of a control policy by calling GetControlPolicy.

GetControlPolicyEnablementStatus.title: GetControlPolicyEnablementStatus
GetControlPolicyEnablementStatus.summary: Queries the status of the Control Policy feature.

GetFolder.title: Retrieve folder information
GetFolder.summary: Calls GetFolder to retrieve the information about a folder.

GetHandshake.title: GetHandshake
GetHandshake.summary: Queries the information of an invitation.

GetPayerForAccount.title: GetPayerForAccount
GetPayerForAccount.summary: Queries the information of a settlement account.

GetPolicy.title: Retrieve information about a specified access policy
GetPolicy.summary: Retrieves information about a specified access policy.

GetPolicyVersion.title: Retrieve a version of an access policy
GetPolicyVersion.summary: Retrieves a version of an access policy.

GetResourceDirectory.title: Query resource directory information
GetResourceDirectory.summary: Queries the information about a resource directory. If the management account calls this operation, the details of the resource directory enabled by the management account are returned. If a member calls this operation, the details of the resource directory to which the member belongs are returned.

GetResourceGroup.title: GetResourceGroup
GetResourceGroup.summary: Queries the information of a resource group.

GetResourceGroupAdminSetting.title: GetResourceGroupAdminSetting
GetResourceGroupAdminSetting.summary: Queries the configurations of a resource group administrator.

GetResourceGroupNotificationSetting.title: GetResourceGroupNotificationSetting
GetResourceGroupNotificationSetting.summary: Queries the notification settings of a resource group.

GetResourceGroupResourceCounts.title: GetResourceGroupResourceCounts
GetResourceGroupResourceCounts.summary: Queries the number of resources in a visible resource group.

GetRole.title: Get role information
GetRole.summary: Queries the information about a role by calling GetRole.

GetServiceLinkedRoleDeletionStatus.title: GetServiceLinkedRoleDeletionStatus
GetServiceLinkedRoleDeletionStatus.summary: Queries the status of the task that is used to delete a service-linked role.

InitResourceDirectory.title: Enable a resource directory
InitResourceDirectory.summary: Calls InitResourceDirectory to enable a resource directory. After you enable a resource directory, the system creates a Root folder and sets the current account as the management account. The management account has all permissions to manage the resource directory.

InviteAccountToResourceDirectory.title: InviteAccountToResourceDirectory
InviteAccountToResourceDirectory.summary: Invites an account to join a resource directory.

ListAccounts.title: ListAccounts
ListAccounts.summary: Queries all the members in a resource directory.

ListAccountsForParent.title: ListAccountsForParent
ListAccountsForParent.summary: Queries the information of members in a folder.

ListAncestors.title: Query all parent folders of a specified folder
ListAncestors.summary: Queries information about all parent folders of a specified folder. The results are displayed in order from top to bottom.

ListAssociatedTransferSetting.title: ListAssociatedTransferSetting
ListAssociatedTransferSetting.summary: Queries the settings of the Transfer Associated Resources feature.

ListAutoGroupingRules.title: Query automatic group transfer rules
ListAutoGroupingRules.summary: Queries the list of automatic group transfer rules.

ListControlPolicies.title: Query control policies
ListControlPolicies.summary: Queries the list of control policies.

ListControlPolicyAttachmentsForTarget.title: Query control policies attached to a node
ListControlPolicyAttachmentsForTarget.summary: Queries the list of control policies attached to a resource folder or member account.

ListDelegatedServicesForAccount.title: ListDelegatedServicesForAccount
ListDelegatedServicesForAccount.summary: Queries the trusted services for which a member is specified as a delegated administrator account.

ListFoldersForParent.title: Query subfolders of a specified folder
ListFoldersForParent.summary: Queries the subfolders of a specified folder.

ListHandshakesForAccount.title: ListHandshakesForAccount
ListHandshakesForAccount.summary: Queries the invitations that are associated with an account.

ListHandshakesForResourceDirectory.title: ListHandshakesForResourceDirectory
ListHandshakesForResourceDirectory.summary: Queries invitations in a resource directory.

ListPolicies.title: List access policies
ListPolicies.summary: Calls ListPolicies to query a list of access policies.

ListPolicyAttachments.title: Query policy attachment list
ListPolicyAttachments.summary: Queries the list of policy attachments by calling ListPolicyAttachments.

ListPolicyVersions.title: List access policy versions
ListPolicyVersions.summary: Queries the versions of an access policy.

ListResourceGroups.title: Query resource group list
ListResourceGroups.summary: Invoke ListResourceGroups to query the list of resource groups.

ListResourceGroupsWithAuthDetails.title: ListResourceGroupsWithAuthDetails
ListResourceGroupsWithAuthDetails.summary: Queries resource groups and their user authorization information.

ListResources.title: ListResources
ListResources.summary: Queries resources that can be accessed by the current account in resource groups.

ListRoles.title: List roles
ListRoles.summary: Queries the list of roles by calling ListRoles.

ListTagResources.title: ListTagResources
ListTagResources.summary: Queries the tags that are added to resource groups or the members in a resource directory.

ListTagValues.title: ListTagValues
ListTagValues.summary: Queries the tag values of a tag key.

ListTargetAttachmentsForControlPolicy.title: Query nodes attached to a control policy
ListTargetAttachmentsForControlPolicy.summary: Queries the nodes to which a control policy is attached.

ListTrustedServiceStatus.title: Query enabled trusted services
ListTrustedServiceStatus.summary: Queries the list of trusted services enabled by the management account or a delegated administrator account.

MoveAccount.title: MoveAccount
MoveAccount.summary: Moves a member account from a folder to another.

MoveResources.title: MoveResources
MoveResources.summary: Moves resources from one resource group to another. You can move multiple resources that reside in different regions, are used by different Alibaba Cloud services, or belong to different resource groups.

PromoteResourceAccount.title: Upgrade a resource account to an Alibaba Cloud account
PromoteResourceAccount.summary: Upgrades a resource account to an Alibaba Cloud account. This is an asynchronous operation.

RegisterDelegatedAdministrator.title: RegisterDelegatedAdministrator
RegisterDelegatedAdministrator.summary: Specifies a member in a resource directory as a delegated administrator account of a trusted service.

RemoveCloudAccount.title: RemoveCloudAccount
RemoveCloudAccount.summary: Removes a member of the cloud account type. After you remove a member of the cloud account type, the member is no longer managed by the management account of the resource directory to which the member belonged.

ResendCreateCloudAccountEmail.title: Resend the confirmation email for creating a cloud account
ResendCreateCloudAccountEmail.summary: Resends the confirmation email for creating a cloud account.

ResendPromoteResourceAccountEmail.title: Resend upgrade confirmation email for a resource account
ResendPromoteResourceAccountEmail.summary: Resends the confirmation email for upgrading a resource account to a cloud account.

RetryChangeAccountEmail.title: RetryChangeAccountEmail
RetryChangeAccountEmail.summary: Resends a verification email for the email address change of a member.

SendVerificationCodeForBindSecureMobileP.title: Send a verification code to a secure phone number
SendVerificationCodeForBindSecureMobileP.summary: Sends a verification code to a secure phone number when you set the secure phone number for a member of the resource account type by calling SendVerificationCodeForBindSecureMobilePhone.

SendVerificationCodeForEnableRD.title: SendVerificationCodeForEnableRD
SendVerificationCodeForEnableRD.summary: Sends a verification code to the mobile phone number bound to a newly created account when you use the account to enable a resource directory.

SetDefaultPolicyVersion.title: SetDefaultPolicyVersion
SetDefaultPolicyVersion.summary: Sets a default version for a permission policy.

SetMemberDeletionPermission.title: SetMemberDeletionPermission
SetMemberDeletionPermission.summary: Enables or disables the member deletion feature.

TagResources.title: TagResources
TagResources.summary: Adds tags to resource groups or the members in a resource directory.

UntagResources.title: UntagResources
UntagResources.summary: Removes tags from resource groups or the members in a resource directory.

UpdateAccount.title: UpdateAccount
UpdateAccount.summary: Changes the display name of a member, or switches the type of a member.

UpdateAssociatedTransferSetting.title: UpdateAssociatedTransferSetting
UpdateAssociatedTransferSetting.summary: Updates the settings of the associated resource group transfer feature by calling UpdateAssociatedTransferSetting.

UpdateAutoGroupingConfig.title: UpdateAutoGroupingConfig
UpdateAutoGroupingConfig.summary: Updates the configuration of the Automatic Resource Transfer feature. You can update only the configuration of the Transfer Existing Associated Resources feature.

UpdateControlPolicy.title: Modify a custom control policy
UpdateControlPolicy.summary: Modifies a custom control policy by calling UpdateControlPolicy.

UpdateFolder.title: Modify folder name
UpdateFolder.summary: Modifies the name of a folder by calling UpdateFolder.

UpdateResourceGroup.title: UpdateResourceGroup
UpdateResourceGroup.summary: Updates the basic information of a resource group.

UpdateResourceGroupAdminSetting.title: UpdateResourceGroupAdminSetting
UpdateResourceGroupAdminSetting.summary: Updates the configurations of a resource group administrator.

UpdateRole.title: Update role information
UpdateRole.summary: Updates the information of a RAM role.
